text: A secret word of 74 letters repeats under the message, one letter per place, so place 75 uses the first letter again. On the sculpture's table, a known letter over its carved letter fixes the key letter in its slot: 24 slots are fixed that way.
The other 50 slots are free. The experiment tried all 26 letters in each, again and again, keeping whatever made the reading look most like English. That is a lot of freedom for 73 letters.

anchor: why it is not a solution
text: The reading scores -3.70 on the English scale, where real English is about -3.6, and the same climb on a shuffled copper scores better, -3.23, so under the rules of 2026-10-15 it fails the baseline gate. Its key takes 356 bits to write down, almost all of its loss of 5.03.
